examples.description: Resolve one Altinn 2 code to its Altinn 3 equivalent

description: Discover the Altinn 3 equivalent of an Altinn 2 service or role code. The 19 June 2026 Altinn 2 deprecation deadline has passed, so this serves remediation for integrations still on Altinn 2. Pass { altinn2_code } (alphanumeric, 1–10 chars, e.g. A0208) for one mapping, or omit it for the whole map. Every response carries the deprecation status computed in Europe/Oslo (deprecation_deadline, days_remaining, deadline_passed). Each entry ships a `verified` flag: gate any production migration on `verified === true`; unverified entries are hints. Deterministic static map (Digdir-sourced); no government system is contacted. Zero-auth REST twin: GET /api/v1/tools/altinn-migration. Failure modes: NOT_FOUND for a code not in the map, VALIDATION_FAILED (INVALID_CODE). Keyless: callable with no API key at all (per-IP limited); a credential without `read:digdir` can't see the tool (-32602). No sandbox mirror; a sandbox bearer runs this keyless path. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/altinn-system-users
description_nb: Finn det tilsvarende i Altinn 3 for en kode fra Altinn 2 (utfasingsfristen 19. juni 2026 er passert, så dette er nå utbedring). Send { altinn2_code } for én tilordning, eller utelat for hele listen. Baser produksjonsmigreringer på `verified === true`. Deterministisk statisk tilordning (Digdir som kilde). Nøkkelfri tvilling i REST: GET /api/v1/tools/altinn-migration. Nøkkelfri: kan kalles uten nøkkel (begrenset per IP); med nøkkel kreves read:digdir. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel kjøres den nøkkelfrie veien.

altinn2_code.description: An Altinn 2 service or role code to resolve (alphanumeric, 1–10 chars, e.g. A0208). Omit to get the entire migration map.

result.description: The migration lookup: `deprecation_deadline` (Oslo), `days_remaining`, `deadline_passed`, and either one `entry` or the full `mappings[]`. Gate production migration actions on `verified === true`.
